changeSet.author: dcre
changeSet.createView: SELECT u.emission_id, u.e2e, u.status FROM (SELECT em.id AS emission_id, r.e2e, r.status, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY em.id, r.e2e ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.response_file DESC) AS pick_rank FROM isr_resp r JOIN prw_emission em ON em.outbound_msg_id = r.orgnl_msg_id) AS u WHERE u.pick_rank = 1

changeSet.author: dcre
changeSet.createView: WITH member_emission AS ( SELECT m.sequence, e.arrival_id, e.id AS emission_id, e.group_id, e.outbound_msg_id FROM prw_emission_member m JOIN prw_emission e ON e.id = m.emission_id ), isr_fam AS ( SELECT h2.arrival_id, r.e2e, r.status, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY h2.arrival_id, r.e2e ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.response_file DESC) AS rn FROM isr_resp r JOIN tx_header h2 ON r.orgnl_msg_id = h2.msg_id OR r.orgnl_msg_id LIKE h2.msg_id || '\_%' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prw_emission pe WHERE pe.arrival_id = h2.arrival_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prw_emission pe2 WHERE pe2.outbound_msg_id = r.orgnl_msg_id) ), sbsr_fam AS ( SELECT h2.arrival_id, r.e2e, r.status, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY h2.arrival_id, r.e2e ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.response_file DESC) AS rn FROM sbsr_resp r JOIN tx_header h2 ON r.orgnl_msg_id = h2.msg_id OR r.orgnl_msg_id LIKE h2.msg_id || '\_%' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prw_emission pe WHERE pe.arrival_id = h2.arrival_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prw_emission pe2 WHERE pe2.outbound_msg_id = r.orgnl_msg_id) ), pbsr_fam AS ( SELECT h2.arrival_id, r.e2e, r.status, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY h2.arrival_id, r.e2e ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.response_file DESC) AS rn FROM pbsr_resp r JOIN tx_header h2 ON r.orgnl_msg_id = h2.msg_id OR r.orgnl_msg_id LIKE h2.msg_id || '\_%' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prw_emission pe WHERE pe.arrival_id = h2.arrival_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prw_emission pe2 WHERE pe2.outbound_msg_id = r.orgnl_msg_id) ) SELECT t.arrival_id, t.sequence, t.e2e, h.client_token AS client, me.outbound_msg_id, me.emission_id, g.source_msg_id, COALESCE(pp.status, pf.status, sp.status, sf.status, ip.status, ifm.status, CASE WHEN v.outcome = 'PASS' THEN 'CTV_PASS' ELSE v.outcome END) AS status, COALESCE(sc.terminal, false) AS terminal, CASE WHEN COALESCE(pp.status, pf.status) IS NOT NULL THEN 4 WHEN COALESCE(sp.status, sf.status) IS NOT NULL THEN 3 WHEN COALESCE(ip.status, ifm.status) IS NOT NULL THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS stage_rank FROM tx_entry t JOIN tx_header h ON h.arrival_id = t.arrival_id LEFT JOIN validation_log v ON v.arrival_id = t.arrival_id AND v.sequence = t.sequence LEFT JOIN member_emission me ON me.arrival_id = t.arrival_id AND me.sequence = t.sequence LEFT JOIN prw_emission_group g ON g.id = me.group_id LEFT JOIN prg_isr_pick ip ON ip.emission_id = me.emission_id AND ip.e2e = t.e2e LEFT JOIN prg_sbsr_pick sp ON sp.emission_id = me.emission_id AND sp.e2e = t.e2e LEFT JOIN prg_pbsr_pick pp ON pp.emission_id = me.emission_id AND pp.e2e = t.e2e LEFT JOIN isr_fam ifm ON ifm.arrival_id = t.arrival_id AND ifm.e2e = t.e2e AND ifm.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN sbsr_fam sf ON sf.arrival_id = t.arrival_id AND sf.e2e = t.e2e AND sf.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN pbsr_fam pf ON pf.arrival_id = t.arrival_id AND pf.e2e = t.e2e AND pf.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN prg_status_class sc ON sc.code = COALESCE(pp.status, pf.status, sp.status, sf.status, ip.status, ifm.status)

changeSet.author: dcre
changeSet.createView: SELECT em.group_id, g.client, g.source_msg_id, m.emission_id, t.e2e, COALESCE(pp.status, sp.status, ip.status, CASE WHEN v.outcome = 'PASS' THEN 'CTV_PASS' ELSE v.outcome END) AS status, COALESCE(sc.terminal, false) AS terminal FROM prw_emission_member m JOIN prw_emission em ON em.id = m.emission_id JOIN prw_emission_group g ON g.id = em.group_id JOIN tx_entry t ON t.arrival_id = em.arrival_id AND t.sequence = m.sequence LEFT JOIN validation_log v ON v.arrival_id = em.arrival_id AND v.sequence = m.sequence LEFT JOIN prg_isr_pick ip ON ip.emission_id = m.emission_id AND ip.e2e = t.e2e LEFT JOIN prg_sbsr_pick sp ON sp.emission_id = m.emission_id AND sp.e2e = t.e2e LEFT JOIN prg_pbsr_pick pp ON pp.emission_id = m.emission_id AND pp.e2e = t.e2e LEFT JOIN prg_status_class sc ON sc.code = COALESCE(pp.status, sp.status, ip.status)

changeSet.author: dcre
changeSet.createView: WITH member_state AS ( SELECT ms.group_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ms.terminal) AS terminal_members, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ms.status IS NOT NULL AND (ms.status = 'CTV_PASS' OR COALESCE(sc.reportable, false)) AND l.e2e IS NULL) AS unreported FROM prg_member_status ms LEFT JOIN prg_status_class sc ON sc.code = ms.status LEFT JOIN prg_delivery_ledger l ON l.client = ms.client AND l.e2e = ms.e2e AND l.status = ms.status AND l.manual_ref IS NULL GROUP BY ms.group_id ), last_response AS ( SELECT e.group_id, max(r.updated_at) AS newest FROM (SELECT orgnl_msg_id, updated_at FROM isr_resp UNION ALL SELECT orgnl_msg_id, updated_at FROM sbsr_resp UNION ALL SELECT orgnl_msg_id, updated_at FROM pbsr_resp) r JOIN prw_emission e ON e.outbound_msg_id = r.orgnl_msg_id GROUP BY e.group_id ) SELECT g.client, g.source_msg_id, CASE WHEN s.terminal_members = g.total_tx THEN 'COMPLETE' ELSE 'IDLE' END AS reason FROM prw_emission_group g JOIN member_state s ON s.group_id = g.id LEFT JOIN last_response lr ON lr.group_id = g.id WHERE s.unreported > 0 AND (s.terminal_members = g.total_tx OR (lr.newest IS NOT NULL AND lr.newest < now() - INTERVAL '120 seconds'))

changeSet.author: dcre
changeSet.createView: SELECT ms.client, ms.e2e, em.outbound_msg_id, em.visible_at, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - em.visible_at)) / 3600 AS age_hours FROM prg_member_status ms JOIN prw_emission em ON em.id = ms.emission_id WHERE em.state = 'VISIBLE' AND em.visible_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT ms.terminal AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prg_status_class sc WHERE sc.code = ms.status AND sc.sla_suppressed)

changeSet.author: dcre
changeSet.createView: SELECT x.client::VARCHAR(16) AS client, COALESCE(x.source_msg_id, h.msg_id)::VARCHAR(35) AS source_msg_id, x.outbound_msg_id::VARCHAR(64) AS outbound_msg_id, x.e2e::VARCHAR(35) AS e2e, x.status::VARCHAR(32) AS status, COALESCE(sc.classification, 'UNKNOWN')::VARCHAR(32) AS classification FROM ext_tx_status x JOIN tx_header h ON h.arrival_id = x.arrival_id LEFT JOIN prg_status_class sc ON sc.code = x.status WHERE x.status IS NOT NULL AND x.stage_rank > 1 AND NOT COALESCE(sc.reportable, false)
